افتكرنا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَكَرْنَا (iftakarnā) /if.ta.kar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
# اُفْتُكِرْنَا (uftukirnā) /uf.tu.kir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
